name: YTLREIT
recent: YTL Hospitality REIT 于2026年11月19日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，营收约1.40亿林吉特，可分配收入同比增长4%至约3,060万林吉特。同期宣布董事局变动，Yeoh家族成员出任交替董事。此外，信托将于2026年11月24日召开第十四届常年股东大会。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，营收约1.40亿林吉特，可分配收入同比增长4%至约3,060万林吉特。
董事局变动：MR YEOH KEONG SHYAN 及 MISS YEOH PEI XIEN 出任交替董事，MR YEOH KEONG WEI 卸任。
将于2026年11月24日召开第十四届常年股东大会。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为1.263亿林吉特，环比下降15.2%，同比基本持平（-0.6%）；净收入为1.196亿林吉特，环比增长191.9%，同比增长112.6%，净利率为94.6%。

recent_en: YTL Hospitality REIT announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026, with revenue of approximately RM140 million and distributable income up 4% year-on-year to about RM30.6 million. Boardroom changes were also announced, with Yeoh family members appointed as alternate directors.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of approximately RM140 million and distributable income up 4% year-on-year to about RM30.6 million.
Boardroom changes: MR YEOH KEONG SHYAN and MISS YEOH PEI XIEN appointed as alternate directors, while MR YEOH KEONG WEI stepped down.
The 14th Annual General Meeting will be held on 24 November 2026.
risks_en: The AGM agenda includes a proposed authority to allot and issue new units of up to 20% of total issued units, which may dilute existing unitholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM126.3 million, down 15.2% quarter-on-quarter and broadly flat year-on-year (-0.6%); net income was RM119.6 million, up 191.9% quarter-on-quarter and 112.6% year-on-year, with a net margin of 94.6%.
